svg.title: Evidence levels of the local agent environment scan
svg.desc: The scan reports file evidence only. Not-detected means no tool-specific evidence. Detected means a tool root, executable or specific skill root exists. Configured means a documented instruction entry exists, or the tool is otherwise detected and a documented skill root contains skills. Runtime loading is deliberately not claimed and shown above the ladder as unverified.
svg.text: no tool root, no executable, no tool-specific skill root
tool root exists, executable found in PATH, or a non-shared skill root exists
documented rule entry, or detected tool + documented skill root with skills
Shared roots such as ~/.agents/skills are reported separately and never count as tool-specific evidence.
Candidate paths can reach detected, never configured.
